interpretations: Rank films across all stores by the number of rows for each `film_id` in `inventory`; return exactly 10 films, with each film’s `film_id`, copy count, and unrounded copy count divided by the count of all inventory rows, ordered by share descending.
Rank films across all stores by copy count and include every film tied at the tenth-place count; return the same fields and unrounded share, ordered by share descending.
queries:
SELECT
  film_id,
  COUNT(*) AS copy_count,
  COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory) AS copy_share
FROM inventory
GROUP BY film_id
ORDER BY copy_share DESC, film_id
LIMIT 10;

WITH film_copies AS (
  SELECT f.film_id, f.title, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS copy_count
  FROM film AS f
  LEFT JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  GROUP BY f.film_id, f.title
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    title,
    copy_count,
    1.0 * copy_count / SUM(copy_count) OVER () AS share,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY copy_count DESC) AS copy_rank
  FROM film_copies
)
SELECT title, copy_count, share
FROM ranked
WHERE copy_rank <= 10
ORDER BY share DESC
